skills.title: Front-End & Mobile

portfolio.title: ClimbIRL — Gamified Productivity App
portfolio.description: Independently built and published a full-stack gamified task RPG on Play Store. Features XP, timezone-aware ranking, atomic achievements, rewarded AdMob economy, Gemini 2.5 Flash photo task verification, and automated Docker deployment to Oracle Cloud.

portfolio.title: Full Stack E-Commerce Platform
portfolio.description: A comprehensive e-commerce system featuring product catalogue search, cart management, secure user authentication, and Braintree payment gateway integration for end-to-end transactions.

portfolio.title: Realtime Code Editor
portfolio.description: A collaborative realtime editor built to facilitate synced coding workflows. Uses WebSockets and Socket.io to allow multiple developers to co-author code seamlessly with zero lag.
